name: Attio
description: Attio CRM — read and write people, companies, deals and custom-object records, manage lists, attributes, notes, tasks, comments and webhooks via the Attio v2 REST API.

methods.label: Identify Token (Self)
methods.description: Identify the current access token: returns { active, scope, client_id, token_type, authorized_by_workspace_member_id, workspace_id, workspace_name, workspace_slug, workspace_logo_url }. Use to confirm auth and discover the workspace. No inputs. Free.

methods.label: List Objects
methods.description: List all system and custom objects in the workspace (people, companies, deals, users, workspaces + any custom objects). Returns { data: [{ id:{ workspace_id, object_id }, api_slug, singular_noun, plural_noun, created_at }] }. No inputs. Free.

methods.label: Get Object
methods.description: Get a single object's config by id or api_slug (e.g. 'people', 'companies', 'deals'). Returns { data:{ id, api_slug, singular_noun, plural_noun } }. Free.

methods.label: Create Object
methods.description: Create a new custom object. Body: data:{ api_slug, singular_noun, plural_noun }. Returns the created object. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Object
methods.description: Update a custom object's slug/nouns. Body: data:{ api_slug?, singular_noun?, plural_noun? }. Returns the updated object. 1 credit.

methods.label: Query Records
methods.description: List/filter/sort records of an object (people, companies, deals, or custom). Body: { filter?, filter_view_id?, sorts?:[{ attribute, direction:'asc'|'desc', field? }], limit? (max 500), offset? }. Returns { data:[{ id:{ record_id, object_id }, web_url, created_at, values }] }. Filter shape: { attribute_slug: value } or { '$or':[...] }. Free.

filter_view_id.description: Use a saved view's filter instead of an inline filter

methods.label: Search Records (Fuzzy)
methods.description: Fuzzy full-text search for records across one or more objects. Body: { query, objects?:['people','companies'], limit? }. Returns matching records ranked by relevance. Free.

methods.label: Get Record
methods.description: Get a single record by object + record_id, with all its current attribute values. Returns { data:{ id:{ record_id, object_id }, web_url, created_at, values } }. Free.

methods.label: Create Record
methods.description: Create a new record (person, company, deal, or custom). Body: { data:{ values:{ attribute_slug: value | [values] } } }. Throws on conflicts of unique attributes — use assertRecord to upsert instead. Returns the created record. 1 credit.

methods.label: Assert (Upsert) Record
methods.description: Create OR update a record matched by a single attribute. Query param matching_attribute = the slug/id used to find an existing record (e.g. 'domains' for companies, 'email_addresses' for people). If a record matches, it is updated; otherwise created. Body: { data:{ values:{...} } }. Returns the asserted record. 1 credit.

matching_attribute.description: Query param — slug/id of the unique attribute used to match, e.g. 'domains'

methods.label: Update Record (Append Multiselect)
methods.description: Update a record by id; for multiselect attributes the supplied values are APPENDED to existing ones. Body: { data:{ values:{...} } }. Returns the updated record. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Record (Overwrite Multiselect)
methods.description: Update a record by id; for multiselect attributes the supplied values OVERWRITE (replace) existing ones. Body: { data:{ values:{...} } }. Returns the updated record. 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete Record
methods.description: Permanently delete a record by object + record_id. Returns {} on success. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Record Attribute Values
methods.description: List the historical/current values of one attribute on a record (e.g. the full history of a company's 'name'). Returns { data:[{ active_from, active_until, value }] }. Free.

methods.label: List Record's List Entries
methods.description: List all list entries that reference a given record — i.e. which lists this record belongs to. Returns { data:[{ list_id, entry_id, ... }] }. Free.

methods.label: List Attributes
methods.description: List all attributes defined on an object or list. target = 'objects' or 'lists'; identifier = the object/list slug or id. Returns { data:[{ id, api_slug, title, type, is_unique, is_multiselect, is_required }] }. Free.

methods.label: Get Attribute
methods.description: Get a single attribute's config by id or slug on an object or list. target = 'objects'|'lists'. Returns { data:{ id, api_slug, title, type, is_unique, is_multiselect } }. Free.

methods.label: Create Attribute
methods.description: Create a new attribute (custom field) on an object or list. Body: data:{ title, api_slug, type, is_required, is_unique, is_multiselect, ... }. type one of: text, number, checkbox, currency, date, timestamp, rating, status, select, record-reference, actor-reference, location, domain, email-address, phone-number, personal-name. Returns the created attribute. 1 credit.

data.description: { title, api_slug, type, is_required, is_unique, is_multiselect, ... }

methods.label: Update Attribute
methods.description: Update an attribute's config (title, description, required/unique flags, etc.) on an object or list. Body: data:{ ... }. Returns the updated attribute. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Select Options
methods.description: List the select options for a select-type attribute on an object or list. Returns { data:[{ id, title, is_archived }] }. Free.

methods.label: Create Select Option
methods.description: Add a new option to a select-type attribute. Body: data:{ title }. Returns the created option. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Select Option
methods.description: Update or archive a select option. Body: data:{ title?, is_archived? }. Returns the updated option. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Statuses
methods.description: List the statuses for a status-type attribute (e.g. a deal's 'stage'). Returns { data:[{ id, title, is_archived, celebration_enabled }] }. Free.

methods.label: Create Status
methods.description: Add a new status to a status-type attribute. Body: data:{ title, celebration_enabled?, target_time_in_status? }. Returns the created status. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Status
methods.description: Update or archive a status on a status-type attribute. Body: data:{ title?, is_archived?, celebration_enabled? }. Returns the updated status. 1 credit.

methods.label: List All Lists
methods.description: List all lists in the workspace (e.g. 'Sales Pipeline', 'Newsletter'). Returns { data:[{ id:{ list_id }, api_slug, name, parent_object, workspace_access }] }. No inputs. Free.

methods.label: Get List
methods.description: Get a single list's config by id or api_slug. Returns { data:{ id, api_slug, name, parent_object } }. Free.

methods.label: Create List
methods.description: Create a new list. Body: data:{ name, api_slug, parent_object, workspace_access, workspace_member_access? }. parent_object is the object slug whose records this list holds (e.g. 'people'). Returns the created list. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update List
methods.description: Update a list's name, slug or access. Body: data:{ name?, api_slug?, workspace_access? }. Returns the updated list. 1 credit.

methods.label: Query List Entries
methods.description: List/filter/sort entries in a list. Body: { filter?, sorts?, limit? (max 500), offset? }. Returns { data:[{ id:{ entry_id, list_id }, parent_record_id, parent_object, entry_values }] }. Free.

methods.label: Create List Entry (Add Record to List)
methods.description: Add an existing record to a list as a new entry, optionally setting list-specific attribute values. Body: { data:{ parent_record_id, parent_object, entry_values:{ list_attr_slug: value } } }. Returns the created entry. 1 credit.

methods.label: Assert List Entry by Parent
methods.description: Upsert a list entry keyed by its parent record: if the record is already in the list its entry_values are updated, otherwise a new entry is added. Body: { data:{ parent_record_id, parent_object, entry_values:{...} } }. Returns the entry. 1 credit.

methods.label: Get List Entry
methods.description: Get a single list entry by list + entry_id, with its entry_values and parent record reference. Free.

methods.label: Update List Entry (Append Multiselect)
methods.description: Update an entry's list-attribute values; multiselect values are APPENDED. Body: { data:{ entry_values:{...} } }. Returns the updated entry. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update List Entry (Overwrite Multiselect)
methods.description: Update an entry's list-attribute values; multiselect values OVERWRITE existing ones. Body: { data:{ entry_values:{...} } }. Returns the updated entry. 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete List Entry (Remove from List)
methods.description: Remove a record from a list by deleting its entry (the underlying record is NOT deleted). Returns {} on success. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Entry Attribute Values
methods.description: List the historical/current values of one list-attribute on a list entry. Returns { data:[{ active_from, active_until, value }] }. Free.

methods.label: List Notes
methods.description: List notes, optionally filtered to a parent record. Query params: parent_object?, parent_record_id?, limit?, offset?. Returns { data:[{ id:{ note_id }, parent_object, parent_record_id, title, content_plaintext, created_at, created_by_actor }] }. Free.

parent_object.description: Filter to notes on this object slug

parent_record_id.description: Filter to notes on this record

methods.label: Get Note
methods.description: Get a single note by id, including its full content. Free.

methods.label: Create Note
methods.description: Create a note attached to a record. Body: data:{ parent_object, parent_record_id, title, format:'plaintext'|'markdown', content, created_at?, meeting_id? }. Returns the created note. 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete Note
methods.description: Permanently delete a note by id. Returns {} on success. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Tasks
methods.description: List tasks (oldest first), optionally filtered. Query params: limit?, offset?, sort?, linked_object?, linked_record_id?, assignee?, is_completed?. Returns { data:[{ id:{ task_id }, content_plaintext, is_completed, deadline_at, linked_records, assignees, created_at }] }. Free.

linked_object.description: Filter to tasks linked to this object

linked_record_id.description: Filter to tasks linked to this record

methods.label: Get Task
methods.description: Get a single task by id, with content, deadline, assignees and linked records. Free.

methods.label: Create Task
methods.description: Create a task. Body: data:{ content, format:'plaintext', deadline_at?, is_completed?, linked_records?:[{ target_object, target_record_id }], assignees?:[{ referenced_actor_type:'workspace-member', referenced_actor_id }] }. Returns the created task. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Task
methods.description: Update a task's completion, deadline, assignees or linked records. Body: data:{ is_completed?, deadline_at?, assignees?, linked_records? }. Returns the updated task. 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete Task
methods.description: Permanently delete a task by id. Returns {} on success. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Threads
methods.description: List comment threads, optionally scoped to a record or list entry. Query params: record_id?, object?, entry_id?, list?, limit?, offset?. Returns { data:[{ id:{ thread_id }, comments[] }] }. Free.

methods.label: Get Thread
methods.description: Get a single comment thread by id, including all comments in order. Free.

methods.label: Create Comment
methods.description: Create a comment, either starting a new thread on a record/entry or replying to an existing thread. Body: data:{ format:'plaintext', content, author:{ type:'workspace-member', id }, thread_id? (to reply) OR record:{ object, record_id } / entry:{ list, entry_id } (to start). Returns the created comment. 1 credit.

data.description: { format:'plaintext', content, author, thread_id? | record? | entry? }

methods.label: Get Comment
methods.description: Get a single comment by id, with its content, author and thread. Free.

methods.label: Delete Comment
methods.description: Permanently delete a comment by id. Returns {} on success. 1 credit.

methods.label: List Workspace Members
methods.description: List all members of the workspace (used to resolve assignees and comment authors). Returns { data:[{ id:{ workspace_member_id }, first_name, last_name, email_address, access_level }] }. No inputs. Free.

methods.label: Get Workspace Member
methods.description: Get a single workspace member by id. Returns { data:{ first_name, last_name, email_address, access_level } }. Free.

methods.label: List Webhooks
methods.description: List all webhooks configured in the workspace. Query params: limit?, offset?. Returns { data:[{ id:{ webhook_id }, target_url, subscriptions, status }] }. Free.

methods.label: Get Webhook
methods.description: Get a single webhook by id, including its event subscriptions and status. Free.

methods.label: Create Webhook
methods.description: Create a webhook. Body: data:{ target_url, subscriptions:[{ event_type, filter? }] }. event_type examples: 'record.created', 'record.updated', 'record.deleted', 'list-entry.created', 'note.created', 'task.created', 'comment.created'. Returns the webhook incl. signing secret. 1 credit.

methods.label: Update Webhook
methods.description: Update a webhook's target URL or subscriptions. Body: data:{ target_url?, subscriptions? }. Returns the updated webhook. 1 credit.

methods.label: Delete Webhook
methods.description: Permanently delete a webhook by id. Returns {} on success. 1 credit.
